hero.title: How can we help?
hero.text: Learn how Bonfiire works, find quick answers and get help with your events.

steps.title: Open Explore
steps.text: See the events and activities happening around you.

steps.title: Search or browse
steps.text: Look for something specific, or scroll to see what's on.

steps.title: Open an event
steps.text: Tap an event to see the details: what, when, where and who's going.

topics.title: Request to join an event
topics.text: Found an event you like? Ask to join and get your ticket.

steps.title: Open the event
steps.text: Find it in Explore, or open a link someone shared with you.

steps.title: Request to join
steps.text: Tap to ask the organizer if you can join.
steps.screenshotHint: Event page: request to join button

steps.title: You're in
steps.text: Once the organizer accepts, your e-ticket is ready and you're in the event chat.

topics.title: Accept an invitation to take part in an event
topics.text: Someone invited you? Let them know if you're coming.

steps.title: Open the invitation
steps.text: Open it from your notifications, or from the link you were sent.

steps.title: Check the details
steps.text: See what's happening, when and where, and who else is going.

steps.title: Accept or decline
steps.text: Accept to get your e-ticket and join the event chat, or decline so the host knows.

topics.title: Find your event ticket
topics.text: Every event you join comes with an e-ticket.

steps.title: Open your events
steps.text: Go to the events you've joined.

steps.title: Open the event
steps.text: Pick the event you're going to.

steps.title: Show your ticket
steps.text: Open your e-ticket and show it when you arrive.

topics.title: Contact the event organizer
topics.text: Ask a question before or during the event.

steps.title: Open the event
steps.text: Go to the event you've joined.

steps.title: Open the chat
steps.text: The event chat connects you with the organizer and everyone going.

steps.title: Send your message
steps.text: Write your question and the organizer can answer you there.
steps.screenshotHint: Sending a message in the chat

topics.title: Navigate with the Appro map
topics.text: Some events move from stop to stop, like an Appro.

steps.title: See the route
steps.text: Open the event to see all the checkpoints on the route.

steps.title: Go to a checkpoint
steps.text: Pick your next stop and head there.

steps.title: Check in and collect your stamp
steps.text: Check in at every checkpoint to collect its stamp.

topics.title: View the event leaderboard
topics.text: See how you're doing at a scored event.

steps.title: Open the event
steps.text: Go to the event you're taking part in.

steps.title: Open the leaderboard
steps.text: See everyone's scores, ranked.

topics.title: Creating a single-venue event
topics.text: For events in one place, like a meetup or a birthday.

steps.title: Start a new event
steps.text: Tap to create an event.

steps.title: Fill in the details
steps.text: Add a name, description, date and time.

steps.title: Choose the location
steps.text: Pick a single location and pin the place.

steps.title: Publish
steps.text: Your event is live, ready to invite people.

topics.title: Creating a multi-checkpoint event
topics.text: For events that move from stop to stop, like an Appro or Fuksiaiset.

steps.title: Start a new event
steps.text: Tap to create an event.

steps.title: Fill in the details
steps.text: Add a name, description, date and time.

steps.title: Add your checkpoints
steps.text: Choose multiple checkpoints and add each stop on the route.

steps.title: Publish
steps.text: Your route is live, ready for hosts and participants.

topics.title: Invite people to attend your event
topics.text: Send invitations to the people you want there.

steps.title: Open your event
steps.text: Go to the event you're organizing.

steps.title: Choose who to invite
steps.text: Pick people to invite, or share the event's link with them.

steps.title: Invitations sent
steps.text: They get your invitation and can accept it. See who's coming in the guest list.

topics.title: Invite a co-host to manage your event
topics.text: Bring in people to help you run the event.

steps.title: Open your event
steps.text: Go to the event you're organizing.

steps.title: Invite a co-host
steps.text: Choose who you want to help and send the invite.

steps.title: They accept
steps.text: Once they accept, they can help you run the event.

topics.title: Invite a checkpoint host for a multi-checkpoint event
topics.text: Put someone in charge of each stop.

steps.title: Open a checkpoint
steps.text: From your event's route, pick the checkpoint.

steps.title: Invite a host
steps.text: Choose who will look after this checkpoint and send the invite.

steps.title: They accept
steps.text: Once they accept, the checkpoint is theirs to run.

topics.title: Accept an invitation to manage an event
topics.text: Someone asked you to co-host? Accept to help run the event.

steps.title: Open the invitation
steps.text: Open it from your notifications.

steps.title: Check the event
steps.text: See the event you're asked to help with.

steps.title: Accept
steps.text: The event shows up in your events, with the tools to help run it.

topics.title: Accept an invitation to manage a checkpoint
topics.text: Asked to host a stop at a multi-checkpoint event? Accept to run it.

steps.title: Open the invitation
steps.text: Open it from your notifications.

steps.title: See your checkpoint
steps.text: Check where it is and what happens there.

steps.title: Accept
steps.text: On the day, scan the groups' tickets and give points at your checkpoint.

topics.title: Manage participants at a single-location event
topics.text: See who's coming and bring more people in.

steps.title: Open the participant list
steps.text: See everyone who has joined your event.

steps.title: Invite people
steps.text: Invite people directly, or share the event link.

steps.title: Keep the list in order
steps.text: Keep track of who's coming as people join.

topics.title: Manage participants at a multi-checkpoint event
topics.text: See who's taking part and bring more people in.

steps.title: Open the participant list
steps.text: See everyone who has joined your event.

steps.title: Invite people
steps.text: Invite people directly, or share the event link.

steps.title: Follow their progress
steps.text: Keep track of participants as they move through the checkpoints.

topics.title: Scan tickets at a single-location event
topics.text: Check people in as they arrive.

steps.title: Open the scanner
steps.text: From your event, open the ticket scanner.

steps.title: Scan the ticket
steps.text: Point the camera at the participant's e-ticket.

steps.title: Checked in
steps.text: The participant is checked in.

topics.title: Scan tickets at a multi-checkpoint event
topics.text: Check participants in at the checkpoints.

steps.title: Open the scanner
steps.text: From your event or checkpoint, open the ticket scanner.

steps.title: Scan the ticket
steps.text: Point the camera at the participant's e-ticket.

steps.title: Checked in
steps.text: The participant is checked in and collects the checkpoint's stamp.

steps.title: Pick the participant
steps.text: At the checkpoint, choose the participant you want to score.

steps.title: Give the score
steps.text: Enter their score for this checkpoint.

steps.title: See the leaderboard
steps.text: Scores add up on the event leaderboard.

cta.title: Still have questions?
text: Contact us and we'll help you out.
